alternative_explanations: A gain may come from structural-shape family clustering or canonical template matching rather than reusable composition; independent induction, the protected anti-nearest fixture and native suites separate these accounts.
confounds: Freeze parsing of the public -1..-7 lossless grammar, first-occurrence integer canonicalization, structural edge-set fragments per output component, duplicate-count aggregation, and deterministic cap-64 selection ordered by descending count then ascending edge count then lexical representation. Match by Jaccard with count/size/lexical tie breaks; compose nested child matches or independently selected output components. Any family branch, raw complete-example retention, algorithm/ordering change, target access, seed collision, post-score tuning or evaluator change invalidates the cohort.
falsification_criteria: Discard this exact implementation without tuning if overall transfer is below 0.95, any family mean is below 0.90, or shared induction fails to exceed the source-identical independent graph by 0.05 on both overall and minimum-family accuracy.
Discard the transfer claim if any registered native suite Pareto-dominates shared quality and every declared full-cost axis.

outcome_policy.negative: A crash rejects only implementation; failure of the protected two-fragment trace/relabeling fixture, semantic baseline gate, integrity, state bound or public-only boundary invalidates the cohort and forbids architectural interpretation.
outcome_policy.null: A valid null makes this exact graph-fragment mechanism dormant without changing capacity, canonicalization, fragment granularity, selection, similarity or composition.
outcome_policy.positive: A valid one-seed success keeps HYP-0020 proposed and authorizes only a preregistered three-seed adversarial replication, never promotion.

predicted_outcome: Explicit equality-linked fragments may retain compositional identity structure lost by recurrent v3, but a one-seed shared score below 0.95 or one collapsed family remains more likely; a valid full-threshold result would authorize replication only.
promotion_criteria: Quick cannot promote; authorize only a three-seed adversarial screen if all capability, sharing, semantic-fixture, state and full-cost Pareto gates pass.
research_question: Can one family-blind graph learner parse the lossless structural grammar, canonicalize atoms by first occurrence, induce at most 64 per-output relation edge-set fragments from pooled worlds and compose matched fragments into answers that transfer across four runner-random unseen families better than source-identical independent induction and registered native specialists?
title: Anonymous 64-fragment graph composition across unseen worlds

invalidation_rules: Invalidate on any derived training and scoring seed collision.
Invalidate if the shared candidate receives a family label or privileged native object.
Invalidate if any training or test value is truncated, sampled or encoded by a family-specific rule.
Invalidate if test results, targets or oracle fields are available during pooled meta-fit.
Invalidate on candidate tuning after any scoring output is observed.
Invalidate if the shared source dispatches on family, native type, slot identity or a hand-written ontology.
Invalidate if the learner retrieves complete training examples without exposing fragment decomposition and a multi-fragment composition trace.
